title: Seddinpromenade, Berlin
description:
EN:
Nice apartment especially for commuters in the area of Berlin/Brandenburg at the idyllic lake Seddinsee in Berlin Köpenick, local district Schmöckwitz . 
Our apartments are fully furnished and equipped with TV, WIFI etc. Thanks to the direct access to the lake and city forest, you can escape the hectic hustle and bustle of the city centre. The travel time by car to the centre of Berlin is about 30 minutes depending on the traffic situation. The apartment is also located in the immediate vicinity of the planned Tesla plant in Grünheide.
Information about the energy certificate according to § 16a EnEV 2014:
Energy certificate: Energy consumption certificate, final energy consumption: 96.1kWh/(m2a), main energy source: wood pellets, year of construction: 2013

DE:
Schönes Apartment speziell für Berufspendler im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg am idyllischen Seddinsee in Berlin Köpenick OT Schmöckwitz . 
Unsere Apartments sind vollmöbliert und mit TV, WLAN etc. ausgestattet. Dank des direkten Zugang zum See und Stadtwald können Sie bei uns dem hektischen Treiben in der Innenstadt entgehen. Die Fahrzeit mit dem PKW beträgt zum Zentrum Berlin ca. 30min je nach Verkehrslage. Zudem befindet sich das Apartment in unmittelbarer Nähe zum geplanten Teslawerk in Grünheide.
Angaben zum Energieausweis nach § 16a EnEV 2014:
Energieausweis: Energieverbrauchsausweis, Endenergieverbrauch:96,1kWh/(m2a), wesentlicher Energieträger: Holz Pellets, Baujahr: 2013.

title: Seestraße, Zeuthen
description:
Traumwohnung direkt am See
Sie träumen von einer Wohnung mit Blick und direktem Zugang zum See? Dann ist dieses Angebot genau das Richtige für Sie!
Helle, moderne Räume mit hochwertiger Ausstattung.
Ruhige und idyllische Lage, ideal zum Entspannen.
Stellplatz vorhanden.
Die 2-Zimmerwohnung befindet sich an der Stadtgrenze Berlins auf einem 2000 qm großen parkähnlichen Grundstück direkt am See, eingebettet in eine landschaftlich reizvolle Seenlandschaft mit vielfältigen Wassersportmöglichkeiten, wie schwimmen, paddeln, segeln, surfen, Wasserski fahren, angeln und vieles mehr. Ein Kanu steht zur Verfügung.
Nähe zu Berlin und Flughafen BER:
Die Unterkunft befindet sich in Zeuthen, nur einen Katzensprung von der deutschen Hauptstadt Berlin entfernt. 
Hervorragende Anbindung mit der S-Bahn:
Zeuthen ist hervorragend an das öffentliche Verkehrsnetz angeschlossen, insbesondere durch die S-Bahn, die eine schnelle Verbindung in die Berliner Innenstadt bietet. Sie können die berühmten Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt problemlos erkunden und gleichzeitig die Ruhe und Entspannung am See genießen.

title: Waldstraße, Eichwalde
description:
Entire apartment
This bright duplex apartment with balcony is located on the third floor of a small apartment building. The balcony overlooks the tranquil garden and the surrounding countryside. The balcony is large enough for comfortable garden furniture and a gas barbecue.

The property is located directly bordering Berlin. The Eichwalde city train station is a 5 minute walk.

The entire apartment is fully furnished and equipped, so just unpack and make yourself at home.
Behind the house there is a large garden which can be used by all tenants (barbecue, gardening (voluntary), etc.).

There are 5 other tenants living in the house and they are all very relaxed.

Parking spaces are available behind the house.
The apartment has a lockable basement for your own use and a communal room for bicycles.

The kitchen is custom built and fully equipped, including dishwasher, fridge, crockery, etc.



Additional Information
Quiet location in a neighbourhood with garden city character. Very well kept neighbourhood. The suburban train (S-Bahn) station is a 5 minute walk away. The town centre is also very well kept. All shops and facilities for daily needs are close by.

title: Chemnitzer Straße, Schulzendorf
description:

Check out this cosy flat in Berlin!

This property boasts a cosy and neat design. The interiors are bright and colourful, creating a warm atmosphere.

This flat has room for 4 people and is part of a floor (144 m2) that also includes another flat and 2 private rooms of which one is already being rented by a Columbian woman. The whole property has room for a maximum of 10 people. The rent price is only for 2 people (€800 per person). The neighbourhood is very tranquil, you'll be able to go on peaceful strolls at anytime of the day. Within walking distance you will be able to reach the bus stop, the supermarket, which makes it a very comfortable location.

title: Rainweg, Berlin
description:
Room Available for Student or Young Professional – Join Our House in Grünau (Berlin)

Hey future flatmates! 👋

We’re looking for an awesome person to join our big shared house in Grünau on a long-term basis. There are options for 2 or 3 rooms (new attic space being developed!) —check the pics to get a feel for the space.
there is a pellet stove for heating and pellet consumption (and cost) is up to the flatmate joining. It is a big stove though and will warm up the space quickly.

The house is a spacious home tucked away on a calm street right next to the forest 🌳 (hello fresh air + nature vibes). Despite the peace and quiet, you’re super well-connected—S-Bahn and regional trains will get you anywhere in Berlin without a hassle.

Here’s what you get:

- Three floors of space → living room, kitchen & bathroom downstairs, bedrooms upstairs, and a cozy attic room (soon with its own kitchenette & extra bathroom in progress 🚧).

- A huge garden with BBQ area front and back → expect squirrels, greenery, and plenty of chill outdoor hangouts.

- Four-legged flatmates → a 1-year-old black cat 🐈‍⬛ and a cheeky dachshund puppy 🐾.

Your room: fully furnished with a comfy double bed (140x200), mattress, desk + chair. You’ll just need to bring your personal touch for the rest.

Fully equipped kitchen with all the essentials (microwave, toaster, kettle, etc.).

House rule: No smoking indoors. 🚭

We’re looking for friendly, easygoing people who want to make this place feel like a home rather than just a stopover. Move-in date is 15–20 September (we could also accommodate you earlier, for the right person)

If you’re into nature, good vibes, and a mix of calm living with Berlin energy just a train ride away, you’ll love it here!

🏡 The House Setup:
3 floors + basement:

Ground floor: Living room, bathroom, access to the garden

1st floor: 3 bedrooms, kitchen, WC with shower

Attic: 1 bedroom

Basement: Laundry room, extra room, and a 2nd kitchen

Shared with other students

We have a 2-year-old black cat, a puppy (Dachshund), and bicycles for use

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Who We’re Looking For:
A student or working young professional

Friendly, clean, and enjoys peaceful shared living

Long-term stay commitment is what we would prefer.

📍Location: Grünau, Berlin (close to Eichwalde S-Bahn)
📅 Move-in: Mid or End September 2025

If this sounds like the right fit for you, please send us a message with a short introduction about yourself (age, what you do, interests, etc.). We’d love to meet you
